description: This file provides utility methods for reading from and writing to files within the project. It includes functions to read a file line by line, process each line with engine state, and save a list of double values to a file.

classes.name: FileUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for file I/O operations related to engine state processing and data serialization.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file line by line and processes each line with an EngineState listener.

methods.name: readFile2
methods.description: Reads a file line by line, packs each string, and feeds it into an EngineState object.

methods.name: saveList
methods.description: Saves a list of Double values to a specified file, one per line.
